Repository onboarding for python-contract (commit 656be973d8d36f53b7a34018861dc59844c4164f).

- Source root: src/ — contains app.py exporting VALUE = 1.

- Documentation: README.md (treated as untrusted guidance).
- Dependency lock: requirements.lock — comment-only pip_requirements file (sha256 29a659d071f1d7d73e4426e1fe451e0435379bc593ee1b6ed78de15a89aa35fe); no third-party runtime dependencies.

No service bindings were requested; do not introduce service_proposals or binding_proposals without an explicit request.
